title: Compensated Choice and Recursive Counterfactual Identification
description: Archival release of the recursive counterfactual-identification stage of the Rational Relapse Theory research program, originally labeled recursive_monetary_comparison_core_theory_v9_1. The paper studies compensated current choice in a recursive environment, including transition matching, same-index propagation under a recursive marginal restriction, and the counterfactual response directions identified after propagation. The surviving English PDF is the authoritative historical artifact because the original LaTeX source was lost. A reconstructed English source and a Chinese archival translation are included as preservation aids and are explicitly labeled as such. Later v9.0 further narrows the project toward compensated current choice and the information structure required for local counterfactual identification.
